$comment: PalDawn (formerly Antaryaan) universal provenance record — descriptive schema. The deterministic validator (validate.mjs, Node built-ins only) is the enforcement source of truth; this file documents the shape for humans and tools.
title: PalDawnProvenanceRecord

record_id.description: Stable unique ID for this record, e.g. npm--react--19.2.8

structure_id.description: Project structure ID for anatomical objects (e.g. structure:coronary.lad); omit for code

medical_scope.description: true when the subject carries medical/anatomical claims (assets, datasets, ontology mappings, journey content). Pure code/tooling: false

path.description: Exact file/object path inside upstream, when applicable

version_or_commit.description: Immutable released version or commit SHA

source_digest.description: Digest of the consumed artifact (e.g. npm sha512 integrity, sha256 of a file)

spdx.description: Exact SPDX ID or LicenseRef-*; fail-closed against zone allowlists

source_url.description: Where the license claim was verified (repo LICENSE file, registry metadata...)

scope.description: Scope of the licence evidence, such as repository-level or exact-object

object_level_status.description: Required as resolved before a medical asset, dataset, or content record may be approved or used

lineage.description: Original source and derivation chain, e.g. BodyParts3D (CC BY-SA 2.1 JP) -> Z-Anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0) -> this object

commands.description: Reproducible commands that produced the output

modifications.description: "None — unmodified" or a description of every change

output_digest.description: Digest of the produced/landed artifact; required non-empty when usage_status = used

required_text.description: Exact attribution text to surface (CREDITS.md / NOTICE.md / UI)

landing_zone.description: app/pipeline are MIT code zones (share-alike material forbidden); content is the CC BY-SA zone

usage_status.description: used = actually incorporated in the repository/build. Never mark used before incorporation

applicability.description: required for medical/anatomical subjects; not_applicable (with rationale) for pure code/tooling

reviewer.description: Named qualified human; required for approved/used medical records

claim_scope.description: Exactly which claims the review covers

source_container.description: Pinned container evidence required by the validator for Z-Anatomy medical assets.

source_object.description: Exact upstream object/data-block identity or evidence that the requested object is unavailable.

ontology_mappings.description: Separately sourced TA2 and FMA mappings; the validator requires immutable source evidence, method, confidence, and basis for medical assets.

adoption_gate.description: Audit disposition. blocked records may validate while planned/pending; medical assets, datasets, and content require clear before approval/use.
